emptyIntegrations.title: No integrations connected
emptyIntegrations.description: Connect Vercel, Render or Cloudflare Workers to sync this project's secrets.

hints.vercel: Create the token under Vercel → Account Settings → Tokens, scoped to the project's team.
hints.render: Create the key under Render → Account Settings → API Keys. Variables are written to the service.
hints.cloudflare: Use an API token with the Workers Scripts: Edit permission. Push only: Cloudflare never returns secret values.

oneWay.title: Sync is one-way
oneWay.body: CriptEnv sends variables to your hosting provider, but it does not learn about anything created or changed directly there: Vercel does not return sensitive variables and Cloudflare does not return secrets. Always edit in CriptEnv. The next sync may overwrite what was changed on the hosting side.
